# docker

Container helpers: aligned image/container tables, log inspection, compose shortcuts, network introspection, and throwaway services.

---

## `docker_cache_last_container`

Show the last container and remember its id in SHELLRC_DOCKER_CACHE so docker_show_logs can pick it up with no arguments.

**Usage**

```sh
docker_cache_last_container
```

**Examples**

```sh
docker_cache_last_container && docker_show_logs
```

**Requires** `docker`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/docker.sh:130`](../../modules/common/docker.sh#L130)

**See also** `docker_show_logs`

## `docker_exec_service`

Run a command inside a compose service.

**Usage**

## `docker_list_tags`

List every tag published for a Docker Hub image. Walks the registry API page by page and stops at the last one.

**Usage**

```sh
docker_list_tags [image] [max-pages]
```

**Examples**

```sh
docker_list_tags golang
docker_list_tags bitnami/postgresql 3
```

**Requires** `curl`, `jq`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/docker.sh:82`](../../modules/common/docker.sh#L82)

## `docker_open_shell`

Open an interactive shell inside a container, preferring bash and falling back to sh. Defaults to the most recent container.

**Usage**

```sh
docker_open_shell [container] [shell]
```

**Examples**

```sh
docker_open_shell
docker_open_shell web /bin/zsh
```

**Requires** `docker`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/docker.sh:173`](../../modules/common/docker.sh#L173)

## `docker_play_create_node`

Create a Play With Docker node and point the local docker client at it. Pass the session URL shown by labs.play-with-docker.com.

**Usage**

```sh
docker_play_create_node <session-url>
```

**Examples**

```sh
docker_play_create_node http://host3.labs.play-with-docker.com/p/35ef3b7d
```

**Requires** `docker`, `docker-machine`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/docker.sh:352`](../../modules/common/docker.sh#L352)

## `docker_play_remove_machines`

Delete every local docker-machine definition under ~/.docker/machine.

## `docker_run_postgres`

Start a disposable PostgreSQL container. Generates a fresh random password for every invocation, passes it through a private temp env-file, and deletes that file on exit via a trap.

**Usage**

```sh
docker_run_postgres [host-port] [database] [user]
```

**Examples**

```sh
docker_run_postgres
docker_run_postgres 55432 appdb appuser
```

**Requires** `docker`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/docker.sh:314`](../../modules/common/docker.sh#L314)

---

## `docker_show_logs`

Show container logs. Uses the arguments if given, else ids piped on stdin, else the id cached by docker_cache_last_container, else the most recent container.

**Usage**

```sh
docker_show_logs [container-or-flag]...
```

**Examples**

```sh
docker_show_logs
docker_show_logs -f --tail 50 web
docker ps -q | docker_show_logs
```

**Requires** `docker`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/docker.sh:146`](../../modules/common/docker.sh#L146)

**See also** `docker_cache_last_container`

---
